jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. V4 2D horizontal fighting-game BODY source candidate. Input image locks identity/costume/anatomy/style ONLY, not its backdrop or original static pose. Create exactly SIX genuinely different chronological full-body BACKWARD-WALK phases, all facing RIGHT in locked side combat camera while stepping backward toward LEFT. Same physical body scale and palette across all six. Freely arrange six complete separated poses in reading order, no fixed-grid border requirement. Actual transparent gaps make each pose separable; never clip limbs, headwear, hair or clothing. Grounded footwork, no floating or jumping, exactly two legs/two hands. 1 front forefoot bears weight, rear foot probes backward; 2 rear foot plants and knees receive weight; 3 front foot draws back into passing stance; 4 support forefoot pushes as other foot probes backward; 5 other rear foot lands and takes weight; 6 front foot collects into compact stance leading naturally into phase1. Two halves alternate legs; NOT six copies of idle and NOT reverse-play of generic forward walk. Keep torso/head level with subtle natural rise/fall; costume and hair follow with modest lag. Clean anime cel sprite color blocks, thin dark colored outline matching reference, preserve small face/hand details. True transparent alpha outside sprites, opaque body inside; no background gradient, glow, floor, shadow, text, labels, grid, assistants or effects. This is candidate animation, not accepted runtime behavior.
